voice.name: Test Voice
voice.basis: The established FGW narrator (same voice id as Invisibility Shield, Real Web Fluid, Glass Climbing V6 and Living Skin voice_provenance.json).

settings_note: The restricted connector exposes no stability / similarity / style / speed controls for eleven_v4 generations; delivery was directed with inline audio tags instead. The brief's suggested numeric settings could not be applied.
prompt: [urgent, hushed, quick] If you hid behind this wall... [alarmed discovery] this machine could STILL WATCH YOU. [brisk, conversational] Scientists built a system that shoots invisible radio waves THROUGH walls. [curious, flowing] And when they bounce off your body, AI creates a moving SKELETON of you. [playful, demonstrating] Raise your hand? It raises its hand. [lower, ominous] But here's where it gets CREEPY. [brisk, building] In a separate experiment, scientists used ordinary Wi-Fi signals to IDENTIFY people walking past. [short, surprised] Even WITHOUT their phones. [confident] They tested 197 people... and identified almost EVERYONE correctly. [leaning in, quietly unsettling] So imagine walking past a café, and it recognizes you without you doing ANYTHING. [conversational, posing a choice] Now would you rather have a CAMERA watching you... Or Wi-Fi that knows who you are?
note_on_prompt: Bracketed tags are delivery directions (not spoken); capitals are emphasis. The spoken words are exactly production/NARRATION_APPROVED.txt.

takes.why: Both takes are word-perfect on Whisper (only Wi-Fi spelling differences). Take 2 is 0.3 s quicker with the same phrasing and a stronger opening line. (The full-take zipformer transcript dropped the opening "If"; decoding the first 4 s of the final narration on its own, with or without 0.4 s of lead-in silence, the same model hears "IF YOU HID BEHIND THIS WALL", so that was a chunking artefact.)

edit.what: Only sentence pauses were shortened (silent samples below -45 dBFS removed from the middle of 11 pauses, 8 ms crossfades). No time-stretch, pitch or EQ.
